payload.answer: Integrated into the existing files, matching the current layout. tests/tui/test_dashboard.py and tests/test_bootstrap.py both already exist, so the new tests belong beside their neighbours rather than in a parallel structure. A dedicated 'coverage gap' suite is the wrong shape twice over: it decays into a junk drawer nobody maintains, and its very name announces that the tests were written for the counter rather than for the behaviour, which invites exactly the line-touching non-tests the acceptance criteria forbid.
